summary: Lists requirements for version 2 of the Internet Open Trading Protocol, which aims to build on version 1's framework for online commerce while replacing its XML messaging and digital signatures with standards-based mechanisms. It divides features into those that will, may, and will not be included.

eli5.summary: IOTP is a set of rules for buying things online. This document is the wish list for the second version, sorted into things it must, might, and will not do.

questions: what is the internet open trading protocol
what features were planned for iotp version 2
